fact: MyJoyOnline says Ghana's Cybersecurity Act, 2020 (Act 1038), covering impersonation, fraud and other cyber offences, can be applied to AI-assisted crimes such as voice cloning and manipulated videos used in scams, though it does not regulate AI itself.
